# qualys_scan_schedule (Resource)

A recurring Qualys VM scan.

Schedules are the declarative way to run scans. A scan launched directly is a job
with no stable identity — re-running it produces a new scan rather than updating
the old one — so this provider models schedules and not individual scan runs.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "qualys_scan_schedule" "nightly_web" {
  title             = "nightly-web-scan"
  option_profile_id = qualys_vm_option_profile.web_tier.id

  asset_group_ids     = [qualys_asset_group.prod_web.id]
  use_default_scanner = true

  occurrence     = "daily"
  frequency_days = 1

  start_hour     = 2
  start_minute   = 30
  time_zone_code = "US-NY"
}
```

## Two ways to say "day of week"

`weekdays` takes day **names** (`monday`, `tuesday`, …) and applies to weekly
schedules. `day_of_week` takes a **number**, 0 being Sunday, and applies to
monthly schedules alongside `week_of_month`. The two are not interchangeable;
the provider validates the names to catch the confusion at plan time.

## Monthly schedules

A monthly schedule needs `frequency_months` plus exactly one day selector:
either `day_of_month`, or `day_of_week` together with `week_of_month`. Setting
both selectors is rejected rather than left to the API to arbitrate.

## Duration, not an end date

`end_after_hours` and `end_after_minutes` cap how long a single scan may run.
They are not an end date for the schedule — the Qualys API has no end-date
parameter. To stop a schedule after a number of runs, use `recurrence`.

## `active` drifts when `recurrence` is set

Qualys deactivates a schedule itself once `recurrence` occurrences have elapsed.
If you set `recurrence`, expect `active` to become `false` without a
configuration change.

## `active` and `active_state`

Qualys reports four states, not two: `0` deactivated, `1` active, `2` active and
not paused, `3` paused. Values 2 and 3 apply to continuous schedules. `active`
is a convenience that treats 1 and 2 as running; read `active_state` when the
distinction matters.

## Notifications

Qualys notifies **distribution groups**, not arbitrary email addresses. Supply
group IDs in `recipient_group_ids` and manage their membership in the Qualys UI.
Recipients are only sent when `notify_before` or `notify_after` is set, which the
API requires.

## Schema

### Required

- **occurrence** (String) How often the scan repeats. One of `daily`, `weekly`, `monthly`.
- **start_hour** (Number) 0–23.
- **start_minute** (Number) 0–59.
- **time_zone_code** (String) Qualys timezone code, for example `US-NY`.
- **title** (String) Name of the scheduled scan.

### Optional

- **active** (Boolean) Whether the schedule runs. Defaults to `true`.
- **asset_group_ids** (Set of String)
- **day_of_month** (Number) 1–31. Alternative to `day_of_week` with `week_of_month`.
- **day_of_week** (Number) 0–6, 0 being Sunday. Used with `week_of_month`.
- **end_after_hours** (Number) Cap on how long the scan may run, 0–119.
- **end_after_minutes** (Number) 0–59.
- **exclude_ips** (Set of String)
- **frequency_days** (Number) Run every N days. Required when `occurrence` is `daily`.
- **frequency_months** (Number) Run every N months. Required when `occurrence` is `monthly`.
- **frequency_weeks** (Number) Run every N weeks. Required when `occurrence` is `weekly`.
- **id** (String) The ID of this resource.
- **ips** (Set of String) Addresses, ranges or CIDR blocks to scan.
- **network_id** (String) Qualys network to scan within.
- **notify_after** (Boolean) Defaults to `false`.
- **notify_after_message** (String)
- **notify_before** (Boolean) Defaults to `false`.
- **notify_before_message** (String)
- **notify_before_time** (Number)
- **notify_before_unit** (String) One of `days`, `hours`, `minutes`.
- **option_profile_id** (String) ID of the option profile defining how the scan behaves.
- **option_profile_title** (String) Title of the option profile, as an alternative to its ID.
- **observe_dst** (Boolean) Adjust the start time for daylight saving. Defaults to `true`.
- **recipient_group_ids** (Set of String) Qualys distribution group IDs to notify.
- **recurrence** (Number) Stop after this many occurrences.
- **scanner_names** (Set of String) Named scanner appliances to scan from.
- **start_date** (String) Date of the first run, as `MM/DD/YYYY`.
- **tag_exclude_ids** (Set of String)
- **tag_include_ids** (Set of String) Asset tag IDs to scan. Switches the schedule to tag-based targeting.
- **tag_include_selector** (String) Whether an asset must match `all` or `any` of the included tags. Defaults to `any`.
- **use_asset_group_scanners** (Boolean) Defaults to `false`.
- **use_default_scanner** (Boolean) Scan from Qualys' external scanners. Defaults to `false`.
- **use_tagset_scanners** (Boolean) Defaults to `false`.
- **weekdays** (Set of String) Days to run on, as names. Required when `occurrence` is `weekly`.
- **week_of_month** (String) One of `first`, `second`, `third`, `fourth`, `last`.

### Read-Only

- **active_state** (Number) Raw Qualys state: `0` deactivated, `1` active, `2` active and not paused, `3` paused.

## Import

```shell
terraform import qualys_scan_schedule.nightly_web 160642
```
